title: xRetry configuration
description: Project-wide retry defaults for xRetry, xRetry.v3, and their SpecFlow and Reqnroll integrations.

$schema.description: The xRetry JSON schema used by editors for completion and validation.

maxRetries.description: The default maximum number of attempts.

delayBetweenRetriesMs.description: The default delay between attempts, in milliseconds.

retryUntaggedScenarios.description: Whether untagged SpecFlow and Reqnroll scenarios use the configured or built-in retry defaults.
